Y. O. REG
No. 338
Date 22/5/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

May 20th 191 6

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
    In consequence of a rumour that the rebels intend
to make trouble, special precautions were taken in
the City last night.
    Sun Yat Sen and the other local rebel leaders
have not been in the least frightened by the assassination
of Chen Chi Lei. They say the latter was to blame for
his own foolhardiness in staying in Shanghai, when his
whereabouts was known to government agents.
    The corpse of Chen Chi lie has been removed
to No.11 Sing Ling Lee 新庆里 Rue Paul Beau. Several
friends called there yesterday and viewed the body.
There are three French policemen on guard at the door
of the house. There was no inquest held. The funeral
will take place this afternoon.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmam Armstrong

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：F.S.G. ASH）

第 338 号
日期 16/5/22

上海工部局。

1916 年 5 月 20 日

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：
    鉴于有谣言称反叛分子意图制造事端，昨夜法租界内已采取特别预防措施。
    孙中山及其他本地反叛领袖并未因陈其美遇刺身亡而有丝毫惊慌。他们称，陈其美在行踪已被政府特工知晓的情况下仍滞留上海，是其自身鲁莽行事所致，咎由自取。
    陈其美的遗体已被移至保罗·博路（Rue Paul Beau）新庆里 11 号。昨日有数位友人前往瞻仰遗容。该宅门口有三名法国巡捕守卫。未举行验尸调查。葬礼将于今日下午举行。

您顺从的仆人，

mmam Armstrong

首席侦探督察。

警察总监。

（批：F.S.G. ASH）
